_comment: Documented divergences of the PHP handlers against the reference redis_interop corpus (comparison block redis_interop: byte equality for keys, static string values and TTL semantics; engine-generated zset members and ban expiry floats pinned by shape; zset scores as floats at 6-decimal precision; json values parsed-then-canonicalized). Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that now passes is red (stale baseline). Root causes: (1) the security-headers Redis config cache, the custom-pattern Redis registry and the fetcher-bound cloud ranges refresh are not ported (KNOWN_GAPS), so those families have no driver; (2) the port stores the GeoIP download bytes verbatim where the reference stores the spec 08 latin-1-decoded string; (3) the dynamic-rules snapshot timestamp renders with PHP's ATOM format instead of the reference's Z suffix and its empty endpoint-rate-limits map encodes as a JSON list.

cases.rio_security_headers_csp_config: No driver: the Redis-backed security-headers config cache is not ported (KNOWN_GAPS, security headers management; the PHP policy computes the map on demand), so no security_headers:csp_config write exists.
cases.rio_security_headers_hsts_config: No driver: the Redis-backed security-headers config cache is not ported (KNOWN_GAPS, security headers management; the PHP policy computes the map on demand), so no security_headers:hsts_config write exists.
cases.rio_security_headers_custom_headers: No driver: the Redis-backed security-headers config cache is not ported (KNOWN_GAPS, security headers management; the PHP policy computes the map on demand), so no security_headers:custom_headers write exists.
cases.rio_custom_pattern_registry_write: No driver: SusPatterns carries no Redis custom-pattern registry (no add_pattern store), so no patterns:custom write exists.
cases.rio_ipinfo_database_cache_write: The port caches the fetched bytes verbatim (src/GeoIp/IpInfoManager.php initialize, setKey('ipinfo', 'database', body)), where the reference stores the spec 08 latin-1-decoded string, so non-ASCII database bytes are stored differently across engines.
cases.rio_cloud_ranges_v2_write: No driver: the PHP cloud refresh path is registry-bound (CloudProviderRegistry::bareProviderNames plus the static CloudFetchers::fetchProviderRanges map, src/Cloud/CloudManager.php refreshProvidersViaRedisHandler); the corpus's arbitrary 'corpus' provider with pinned ranges has no injection seam and fetchProviderRanges returns [] for unknown providers.
cases.rio_dynamic_rules_snapshot_write: The stored snapshot carries timestamp '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' (DynamicRules::dumpSnapshot formats with DateTimeInterface::ATOM, src/Rules/DynamicRules.php) where the reference payload renders '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'; the empty endpoint_rate_limits map also encodes as a JSON list instead of an object, which a parsed-object comparison cannot observe.
